description: Claude's visual review of the 136 game-1 candidates on the review page (pass, turnover, shot, loose; at least 100 mm). One verdict per candidate with a confidence 0-100 that the verdict is right; low confidence means the user should check it.
method: Per candidate, one image row: puck-centred crops 0.3 s before the release, at the release (with the passer's slot drawn) and at the reception (with the receiver's slot drawn), 0.4 s after the reception, and a darkest-pixel composite of every registered frame of the flight with the measured line.

Judged: is the puck really moving along the line (streak in the composite, puck visible at both ends); which kit (white/blue = Nygård W, yellow = Fjermestad E) is at each end; hands in the rink (stoppages); splits and out-and-back tracking jumps.

Reach lists (every slot within 75 mm of each end) were used to name a figure when the kit at the puck disagrees with the automatic nearest slot. Figures stand tall and the camera looks down at an angle, so a figure in front can cover the puck without touching it; this limits who-judgements.

verdicts.ok: the candidate is right as listed
verdicts.fix: right movement, wrong kind or figures (see fix)
verdicts.wrong: not a play to record (tracking error, stoppage, mid-flight piece, carry)
verdicts.unsure: Claude can't tell; the user should look
